Free self-hosted ERP with inventory, invoicing, manufacturing, accounting, and CRM in one local-first app.


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v2.8.0 -->

## What's Changed
• Document all OpenAPI parameters and enforce release coverage by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/395
• Clean up test warnings by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/398
• Scanning an item sold by weight or measure adds everything left in the lot by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/396
• Import an Odoo backup by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/397
• Import from Sage 50 / Peachtree by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/400
• Tax rates in force for new companies, every default tax on a new line, and steadier document numbers by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/399
• Help pages, Help for this page, and free Celerp AI questions by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/401
• Accountants screenshots：client companies, fixed assets, bank reconciliation by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/409
• Fix：choosing a business type on a new install opens the dashboard by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/402
• Reconciliation history, protected completed reconciliations, and two journal fixes by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/410
• Invoice part of a memo by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/411
• Merged lots without a known cost show no cost, and freight stays separate from goods cost by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/412
• Safer store syncing：per-record directions, a reviewed first sync, and channel controls by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/403
• Celerp AI messages read in your language by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/413
• v2.8.0 release fixes by @ngsevers in https://github.com/celerp/celerp/pull/416


**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/celerp/celerp/compare/v2.7.0...v2.8.0
